QuestInfo.name: OSSS Mission 3:  Alien Photo
QuestInfo.1: Use the #bOSSS Camera#k to take photographs of #b3 Unidentified Dexterous Aliens#k. \r\n\r\nYou can use the camera by #bdouble clicking on it in front of an Unidentified Dexterous Alien#k.
QuestInfo.2: Receive this mission again after completing the other missions.

0.0: You've been issued a special mission from the OSSS. You can complete it if you have the #b#t4032716##k.

yes.0: I see that you have the #b#t4032716##k. I will issue you Mission 3.
yes.1: Reports are coming in that #bUnidentified Dexterous Aliens#k have been patrolling Maple World. Please take this OSSS camera and double-click on it to take photos of them each time you see them.
yes.2: If you bring back 3 alien photos, you will receive a medal. You can take medals to #b#p9250135##k to upgrade your suit.

no.0: Idle chat can wait until after you've saved Maple World...

yes.0: Thank you for your work. Here is your medal. Head over to #b#p9250135##k to purchase various cells that can be used to upgrade your suit.
yes.1: And as for the #b#t4032720##k, submit it with the other ones once all four missions have been completed.

default.0: Looks like you haven't finished the mission just yet...
